_readme: Frame and install copy for the Frame Types screen. desc is the one sentence under the title. outside captions sit under the two yard pictures. sideLabels are the big words under the side picture (four at most). steps are the three 'what we do' lines. compare is the quick row: stucco, mess, and time. The price in that row is not stored here. It comes from installType in data/install.json: zbar -> standard (Jump Frame, $360), block -> block ($380), nailfin -> stucco-fin (Nail Fin RnR Stucco, $400). The pictures are original SVGs in js/pages/frame-types.js. The comment at the top of that file lists the guides that were reviewed and not copied.

types.name: Retrofit / Z-bar
types.desc: The new window sits inside the old frame. We do not touch the stucco.

types.name: Block frame
types.desc: The window fits in the block opening. No fin, and no stucco cut.

types.name: Nail fin
types.desc: We cut the stucco back, nail the fin on, then patch and paint.
